description: This file defines an enum MessageHeaderDefinition which enumerates well-known message headers used within the Eclipse Ditto project. Each enumeration specifies attributes like the header key, Java type, whether it's read from or written to external headers, and associated value validators. It includes methods for looking up headers by key and validator support.

classes.name: MessageHeaderDefinition
classes.description: An enumeration providing definitions for standard message headers, including their keys, data types, validators, and meta-properties regarding external header interactions.

methods.name: forKey
methods.description: Static method to find a MessageHeaderDefinition based on a given header key, returning an Optional containing the matching HeaderDefinition if found.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the header key associated with this enumeration value.

methods.name: getJavaType
methods.description: Returns the Java class representing the type of the header value.

methods.name: getSerializationType
methods.description: Returns the class type used for serializing the header value.

methods.name: shouldReadFromExternalHeaders
methods.description: Indicates whether this header is read from external headers.

methods.name: shouldWriteToExternalHeaders
methods.description: Indicates whether this header is written to external headers.

methods.name: validateValue
methods.description: Validates the given header value using the associated validator.
